title: Does the Malaysian SnR method find better entries than chance? A codified test on crypto, gold and silver against matched random entries
description: Code, result tables, robustness checks and literature map for a codified test of Malaysian SnR (MSNR), a social-media support-and-resistance method, on Bitcoin, Ether, Solana, a gold-backed token, gold and silver at 5-minute to daily bars. Every strategy trade is compared with random entries that share its stop and target geometry, costs and trend direction; a 116,708-variant search is corrected for false discoveries, and a look-ahead error in limit-entry variants is documented and fixed.
